prompt:
Return exactly one JSON object with the sole top-level key resources, whose value is an array of Kubernetes resource objects. No Markdown fences, comments, explanations, duplicate keys, or additional resources. Use Kubernetes 1.34 API schemas. This is a static configuration task; do not execute commands or contact a cluster.

Create exactly one networking.k8s.io/v1 NetworkPolicy named api-isolation in namespace bench. Select app=api pods; policyTypes must list Ingress and Egress. Allow ingress only on TCP 8080 from pods role=web within namespaces team=frontend: put both selectors in the SAME peer (AND semantics). Allow egress only to kube-dns pods (k8s-app=kube-dns) in kube-system (namespace label kubernetes.io/metadata.name=kube-system), on UDP 53 and TCP 53. Use exactly one ingress rule with one peer and one port, and one egress rule with one peer and those two ports; no additional rules. Assume the stated namespace and pod labels exist. Ordering of policyTypes and network-policy rule/peer/port arrays is irrelevant; duplicates are not allowed.

errors: expected an object containing only 1–16 resources
